project_description: Develop an AI-powered application that summarizes meeting transcripts and extracts key decisions and action items.
objectives: Generate concise summaries of meeting transcripts.
Identify key decisions made during meetings.
Extract action items and assigned responsibilities.
requirements: Accept meeting transcripts in text format.
Extract action items and responsible persons.
constraints: Do not invent decisions or action items.
The prototype supports text input only.
deliverables: Decision and action item extraction module.
